title: Anna and the Cold Day
text:
Today it is cold and rainy. Anna wears a warm coat, a hat and boots. She takes an umbrella because it is raining.

Her brother Ali wears a t-shirt and shorts. He says he is not cold. Tomorrow will be sunny, so they will wear light clothes.

options: a warm coat, a hat and boots

questions.text: What does Ali say about the cold?
options: He says he is not cold.
He says he is very cold.
He says he has a coat.

questions.text: How does Anna feel about the weather?
options: She is ready for the cold rain.
She is happy that it is hot.

questions.text: Why will Anna and Ali probably wear light clothes tomorrow?
options: Because the weather will be warm and sunny.

vocabulary.definition: something you hold over your head to stay dry in the rain
shoes that cover the foot and the ankle, worn in cold or wet weather
with a lot of bright sunshine

paragraph_translations: Bugün hava soğuk ve yağmurlu. Anna sıcak bir mont, bir şapka ve bot giyiyor. Yağmur yağdığı için bir şemsiye alıyor.
Erkek kardeşi Ali tişört ve şort giyiyor. Soğuk olmadığını söylüyor. Yarın hava güneşli olacak, bu yüzden hafif kıyafetler giyecekler.
